stated_position.source: Both component parties had publicly pro-conscription stated positions: Ben-Gvir supports Haredi service as a religious commandment (Haredi Magav); Smotrich demanded 'real and rapid' Haredi IDF recruitment with specific targets; voted -2 reflects coalition-pressure outcome, not stated platform

voted_position.source: Partly a proxy: three of the nine mapped votes are opposition no-confidence motions, and the rest are bills sanctioning draft evasion. Opposition parties of every stripe back no-confidence motions to bring the government down, so a 'for' vote there is weak evidence of a party's own view on conscription (the Joint List, for example, states it opposes conscription sanctions). — Knesset vote data aggregated from MK-level votes via oknesset.org. Based on 9 25th-Knesset votes, e.g. Jan 9 2023: no-confidence on dismantling Israel's Jewish democratic character (incl. Haredi exemption); Nov 25 2024: no-confidence on government sabotaging equal conscription; Jul 14 2025: no-confidence on advancing conscription law that undermines equal burden (+6 more)
